questions.q: What did the Time Traveller suggest was a misconception taught at school about mathematical lines and planes?
choices: The existence of lines and planes
The thickness of lines and planes
The length, breadth, and thickness of lines and planes

choices: Because the Time Traveller spoke in a confusing manner
Because the Time Traveller challenged some universally accepted ideas
Because the Time Traveller suggested lines and planes didn't exist
